description: Prepare, verify, publish, and recover releases without conflating local work with external authority.
requiredOutcomes: The exact version, source, tag, artifact or registry, and authorized side effects are identified.
Version metadata, release notes, artifact contents, and project gates are verified.
Preparation and readiness stop before repository or external mutation unless execution is explicit.
Partial states have a non-destructive recovery path.
forbiddenOutcomes: Preparation is treated as permission to tag, push, publish, or deploy.
A shared tag is silently moved or a published version is reused.
A release gate is skipped or weakened to obtain a passing result.
A prepared or published artifact is reported as deployed without deployment evidence.
